title: PMS compliance dos and don'ts
objectives: Hold the required certification and APRN before dealing.
Show performance net of fees against the benchmark.
body_md:
| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Hold NISM XXI-A and a valid APRN before dealing with PMS clients | Source PMS business without an APRN |
| Document suitability for every client | Treat the ₹50 lakh minimum as proof of suitability |
| Share the Disclosure Document and explain every fee in rupees | Quote only headline or pre-fee returns |
| Show performance net of fees, against the benchmark and peers | Cherry-pick periods or strategies to flatter returns |
| Mention the direct onboarding option | Take or imply upfront commission or fees |
| Record the reason for every recommendation and exit | Recommend switches that serve commission |
| Escalate complaints and share the path (provider, SEBI SCORES, Smart ODR) | Promise returns or recovery timelines |

All investor-facing material from this manual needs compliance review before it is published or shared with clients.

example: A client asks for the best PMS return. You show after-fee returns against the benchmark and peers over 3 and 5 years, not a cherry-picked quarter.
say: Here's the complaint path: provider, SEBI SCORES, then Smart ODR.
I can't promise returns or recovery timelines.
never: Source PMS business without an APRN.

talk_track.title: Dos and don'ts
talk_track.text: Finally, compliance. Do: hold NISM XXI-A and a valid APRN; document suitability for every client; explain every fee in rupees; show returns net of fees, against the benchmark and peers; mention the direct onboarding option; record the reasons for every recommendation and exit; and share the escalation path for complaints. Don't: source PMS business without an APRN; treat the fifty lakh minimum as proof of suitability; quote headline or pre-fee returns; cherry-pick periods or strategies; take or imply upfront commission; recommend switches for commission; or promise returns or recovery timelines.

check.q: Which of these is a compliance DON'T?
o: Treating the ₹50 lakh minimum as proof of suitability
Showing performance net of fees vs benchmark
check.why: Also don't source business without an APRN, quote pre-fee returns, or take upfront commission.

check.q: What is the PMS complaint escalation path?
o: Provider, then SEBI SCORES, then Smart ODR
check.why: Escalate complaints promptly and share the path with clients.

check.q: How must PMS performance be shown?
o: Net of fees, against the benchmark and peers
check.why: Show performance net of fees, against the benchmark and peers.
